# MNIST with Adam Optimizer Example
# This configuration shows how to use the Adam optimizer instead of SGD

[dataset]
# Data file paths (generated by mnist.py)
train_images = examples/mnist/data/mnist_train_images.mat
train_labels = examples/mnist/data/mnist_train_labels.mat
test_images = examples/mnist/data/mnist_test_images.mat
test_labels = examples/mnist/data/mnist_test_labels.mat

# Dataset dimensions
train_size = 60000
test_size = 10000
input_size = 784         # 28x28 pixels flattened
output_size = 10         # Digit classes 0-9
label_format = integer_indices  # Labels are integers 0-9

[training]
# Training hyperparameters
epochs = 10
batch_size = 50
# Adam typically uses smaller learning rates than SGD
learning_rate = 0.001

# Use Adam optimizer (options: sgd, adam)
optimizer = adam

# Adam hyperparameters (only used when optimizer = adam)
adam_beta1 = 0.9        # Decay rate for 1st moment (usually 0.9)
adam_beta2 = 0.999      # Decay rate for 2nd moment (usually 0.999)
adam_epsilon = 1e-8     # Numerical stability constant

[architecture]
# Neural network architecture (same as MNIST SGD example)

# Input layer (784) -> Hidden layer 1 (16) with ReLU
layer = dense 784 16 relu

# Hidden layer 1 -> Hidden layer 2 (16) with residual connection
layer = residual_dense 16 16 relu

# Hidden layer 2 -> Output layer (10) with softmax for classification
layer = dense 16 10 softmax
